_about: App library for the Flag Hub and night shift. state: on (normal), focus (look here first at every step), off (paused: don't build or look). lane: cloud or pc. labels: the flag labels that belong to this app. vision: what it's for, what it must never become, current priorities. Suggestions must tie back to the vision. denied: suggestions he turned down (never re-propose these). say: spoken nicknames the Siri inbox matches. otherSay: nicknames for labels that aren't apps.
